definitions.explanation: A set phrase said when leaving home or the office. Literally means 'I will go and come back.' The response is {行|い}ってらっしゃい.

examples.japanese: ⟦じゃ→じゃ：03040_ja⟧、{行|い}ってきます⟦ね→ね：09474_ne⟧。
⟦{学校|がっこう}→学校：00055_gakkou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{行|い}ってきます。
⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{行|い}ってきます。⟦{夜|よる}→夜：00487_yoru⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{帰|かえ}ります→帰る：00508_kaeru⟧。
examples.english: I'm going to work. I'll be back in the evening.

examples.japanese: ⟦{毎朝|まいあさ}→毎朝：00966_maiasa⟧⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧⟦たち→達：01551_tachi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧「{行|い}ってきます」⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{言|い}って→言う：00515_iu⟧、⟦{学校|がっこう}→学校：00055_gakkou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{出|で}かけます→出かける：00833_dekakeru⟧。
examples.english: Every morning, the children say 'I'm leaving' and head off to school.

notes:
{行|い}ってきます is a set phrase said when leaving home or office, literally meaning "I will go and come back."

ETYMOLOGY:
- ⟦{行|い}って→行く：00119_iku⟧: going (te-form of ⟦{行|い}く→行く：00119_iku⟧)
- きます: will come (polite form of ⟦{来|く}る→来る：00254_kuru⟧)

USAGE:
Said when leaving a place you intend to return to. Implies "I'm going (and I'll be back)."

RESPONSE:
⟦{行|い}ってらっしゃい→行ってらっしゃい：01030_itterasshai⟧: Take care / See you later (said by the person staying)

RELATED WORDS:
- {行|い}ってきます: I'm leaving (going out)
- ⟦{行|い}ってらっしゃい→行ってらっしゃい：01030_itterasshai⟧: Take care (response)
- ⟦ただいま→ただいま：01062_tadaima⟧: I'm home (when returning)
- ⟦お{帰|かえ}りなさい→お帰りなさい：01042_okaerinasai⟧: Welcome back (response)

CULTURAL NOTE:
This exchange is a fundamental part of daily Japanese life, used in homes, offices, and even among friends.
